services.desc: The Museum is currently conducting an exhibit to celebrate the 100th birthday of President John F. Kennedy. Kennedy was born on May 29, 1917. The display features items from the collection of Michael Bottiaux of Herrin, in addition to items from another private collection. Bottiaux has been collecting for around 50 years and has amassed an impressive collection. The society greatly appreciates him sharing his collection. The exhibit features items from several phases of Kennedy’s life and political career. blurb: The Union County Historical and Genealogical Society was originally formed in 1974 with the purpose of preserving and promoting local history. The society developed a relationship with the Cobden Museum in the 1980s. The museum was founded in 1961 and had amassed an impressive collection that was in need of preservation. It had also developed into a local and popular tourist attraction.
